name: IBus WeChat candidate popup fix
description: Normalizes device-pixel-scaled relative cursor coordinates sent by WeChat's Qt/IBus plugin (SetCursorLocationRelative) and re-anchors on window changes, so the IBus candidate popup stays near the text cursor under fractional scaling (125%). Only touches the wayland/relative channel; GTK/absolute clients (e.g. gnome-terminal) are unaffected. Remove when upstream fixes the Qt plugin.
